model_annotation: A bar chart depicts the effect sizes of different models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) across various IE (Interpretability of Elementary) family categories as well as categories 'Isolate,' 'Semitic,' and 'Uralic.' The horizontal axis labels represent the different IE families, including Baltic, Germanic, Indic, Romance, Slavic, and other IE families. In the 'Uralic' category, three models (mBERT-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2) are compared, while in the 'Semitic' category, only mBERT-L2 and mBERT-B2 are included. The effect size is shown on the vertical axis, measuring in a pre-defined scale. Each visa bar of the chart is color-coded to distinguish the models analyzed.
